definition: a shop where books are sold
description: A young man in round glasses, a denim jacket and a backpack stands in a narrow aisle of a packed bookshop, tall shelves of books on both sides of him and knee-high stacks of new titles on the floor. He holds a thick hardback open in both hands and lets the pages riffle past his face, mouth open in amazement. He turns a pink-jacketed book over, flips through a second heavy volume, then hugs an enormous oversized book to his chest. At the end he holds a huge book open above his head and looks up as the pages fan out over him.
transcript: Oh! Oh! Aha! Oh! Oh! Oh! Oh! Whoa!

en.question: What is the young man doing?

de.answer: Er blättert in einer Buchhandlung ein Hardcover durch.
